item.stem: What is the organelle that breaks down worn-out cell components using digestive enzymes?

Ribosome: the structure that assembles proteins using messenger RNA instructions. This describes a different concept in the same topic.

item.stem: Which term matches this description: “the gel-like material where many cell reactions take place”?

distractors.why: Plasmodesma: the channel that connects the cytoplasm of neighboring plant cells. This describes a different concept in the same topic.

Cell membrane: the selectively permeable boundary that regulates movement into and out of cells. This describes a different concept in the same topic.
